consequence.statement: New optional capability to select ACME certificate profiles; the evidence states no operational impact for existing setups.

original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds support for selecting ACME certificate profiles (e.g. tlsserver, shortlived) when requesting certificates from an ACME CA.

decision.reason: [ev-50f787991f0d] describes ACME certificate profile selection as a new capability that lets users request different categories of certificates (e.g. `tlsserver` or `shortlived`) and gives users "greater flexibility". It says nothing about existing Issuers or Certificates failing, being rejected or behaving differently when no profile is selected. A new opt-in option with no stated effect on environments that do nothing fits kind none (informational) with low severity. Proposal P4's behavior-change describes what users can now do, not what happens to an environment that does nothing.
